banners.prompt:
Create a photo of a 55-year-old Bulgarian woman at home in Bulgaria in the daytime. She has short wavy light ash-blonde hair with a few natural grey strands, light blue eyes, rosy cheeks, natural fine laugh lines, reading glasses hanging on a thin chain around her neck, light natural make-up. She wears a teal knitted cardigan over a white blouse. She sits at a small table on her glazed balcony full of potted flowers and green plants, bright soft daylight, a sketchbook and pencils on the table. Lively, cheerful expression, a big warm smile, looking straight into the camera.

PHOTO STYLE (critical): it must look like a real, unedited photo taken with an ordinary smartphone camera (like an Instagram story or a selfie video still). Natural light, natural colours, real skin texture with pores and fine lines, slight phone-camera noise, normal phone depth of field. NOT glossy, NOT retouched, NOT cinematic, NOT a stock photo, NOT an advertising photo, no beauty filter, no studio lighting, no heavy background blur, no HDR look.
FRAMING: vertical 9:16, the phone is on a small stand at eye level, so she looks straight into the lens. Upper body and face clearly visible, head in the upper third.
The input image is only a blank grey canvas used for size: ignore it completely and replace it entirely with the photo. The image has plain bars along two edges purely as padding: fill the whole frame naturally with the photo, no bars, no borders.
Do not add any text, letters, logos, watermarks or captions anywhere. Do not show any book in this photo. No other people in the photo.
